svg.title: Brooks's law
svg.desc: A late ride sharing project has 4 engineers and 6 communication paths. Six engineers join one by one and the paths grow to 45, because n people have n times n minus 1 over 2 pairs. The original 4 now spend half their week onboarding, and the launch, already 4 weeks behind, slips 3 more weeks.
svg.text: half their week goes to the newcomers
Six more engineers: 6 paths become 45 and the launch slips 3 more weeks.
